description: Allow base merges on one crew, or put it back to its instructions. A crew merges its base branch only when it conflicts or a person asked by name, and never when its task or a person's note said not to (base_merge_forbidden). mode "allow" lifts that prohibition for this crew from its next round; it merges nothing by itself (amend the crew, with mergeBase: true to ask for the merge). mode "default" follows the task and notes again. Recorded with your name in the audit trail. Requires `approve` scope. Only call when the operator asks.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

mode.description: "allow" lifts a prohibition on merging the base; "default" follows the instructions again.

name: anyforge_set_crew_base_merge
title: Set crew base merge
